summary: Implement CS-CLOUD-IAM-003: Cloud IAM API boundary now requires the ADR-0342 `Oyatie-Version` public date carrier, accepts only the three Cloud IAM manifest-declared versions, rejects missing/unsupported carriers before authorization, idempotency ledger writes, or domain mutation, and declares the required header in the OpenAPI 3.2.0 contract.

baseline_diff.before: Cloud IAM API boundary carried request id, tenant id, and idempotency key but not the public API date version. The OpenAPI contract also lacked `Oyatie-Version` parameters.
baseline_diff.red_test: cargo test -p oya-cloud-iam-api identity_provider_mutation_api_rejects_missing_or_unsupported_oyatie_version_before_ledger -- --nocapture failed before implementation: missing default-version constant, boundary fields, and public-version error variants.
baseline_diff.after: CloudIamApiBoundaryContext and CloudIamApiReadBoundaryContext carry `oyatie_version`; validation rejects blank or unsupported versions with 400-class API errors before idempotency and domain calls. Identity-provider create/update/delete tests prove invalid version carriers leave ledgers empty and do not mutate the directory. OpenAPI declares `Oyatie-Version` as a required enum date header on the Cloud IAM public operations.

best_practice_research.question: Public REST API version-carrier enforcement for Cloud IAM boundary handlers.
best_practice_research.version_date_context: Researched on 2026-05-23 against official/upstream sources and repo ADRs ADR-0258, ADR-0342, and ADR-0352.

official_upstream_sources.establishes: OpenAPI 3.2.0 is the authoritative contract format for HTTP APIs and supports header parameters in operation parameter lists.
GitHub REST API versions use date-based names selected by a request header and unsupported versions receive explicit failure responses.
Stripe supports request-time API version override with a version header while account defaults handle unpinned requests.

repo_authority: docs/decisions/ADR-0342-api-versioning-hybrid-date-public-semver-sdk.md B2.001-B2.004: YYYY-MM-DD public versions and `Oyatie-Version` header carrier.
docs/decisions/ADR-0352-oyatie-from-scratch-architecture-handoff.md: public API versions are YYYY-MM-DD and carried by Oyatie-Version, URL date prefix, and oyatie_version.
best_practice_research.implementation_handoff: Keep version negotiation at the API boundary. Domain logic receives typed business requests only; unsupported public-version carriers never enter IAM domain mutation or idempotency-ledger recording.

findings: One shared boundary validator and constants avoid route-specific branching or duplicate domain rules.
The handler uses the repo-canonical date header model and contract-level required header declaration rather than implicit unversioned mutation behavior.

Regression covers missing and unsupported version carriers for create/update/delete, including empty-directory cases that would otherwise hit domain errors, proving boundary rejection precedes domain business rules.
Public constants expose default/supported versions to tests and future adapters without parsing the manifest at handler time.
Focused RED/GREEN test, full API package tests, Cloud IAM package tests, clippy, rustfmt, and API semver gate passed.

alternatives_named: Accept unversioned requests and rely on tenant default later
Parse API versions in the domain layer
Validate `Oyatie-Version` at API boundary against Cloud IAM declared versions
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: Boundary validation is the smallest clean-architecture implementation of ADR-0342 for this crate; domain stays free of public transport negotiation.
rejected_reasons: Unversioned mutation paths contradict CS-CLOUD-IAM-003 acceptance.
Domain-layer parsing would leak transport/version negotiation into IAM business logic.

findings: Invalid version requests fail before authorization/idempotency/domain side effects; existing authorization-gated and idempotency-keyed mutation tests remain green.
Version validation is a trim plus fixed small-slice membership check; no I/O, allocation-heavy parsing, or manifest read on hot paths.
Evidence bundle and audit-chain row cover the public API contract/version enforcement change.
Additive API request field/contract/test/evidence change; revert is local to Cloud IAM API boundary and contract.
Error responses expose stable error codes/details for missing and unsupported public API versions.
Supported versions mirror Cloud IAM manifest declarations and can be audited against OpenAPI enum carriers.
Business logic remains in oya-cloud-iam-domain; API crate owns request/header normalization and idempotency fingerprinting only.
Clean architecture direction preserved: API boundary validates public carrier before translating to domain input; domain crate unchanged.
New regression plus existing create/update/delete authorization and idempotency tests cover the CS-CLOUD-IAM-003 acceptance criteria.
Evidence records RED/GREEN, scoped Cloud IAM verification, API semver gate, and known OpenAPI runtime-binding gap.

remaining_risks: `./bin/oya doc openapi --contracts-dir contracts --format json` still fails on missing runtime binding inventory for createCloudIamIdentityProvider; API semver contract validation passes.
